newsitem.title: GERMANY: US scholar says German neo-Nazi threat exaggerated.
newsitem.headline: US scholar says German neo-Nazi threat exaggerated.

text.p: U.S. Holocaust scholar Daniel Goldhagen, whose controversial recent book branded pre-war Germans as bloodthirsty anti-Semites, said on Monday foreigners exaggerated the importance of neo-Nazis in reunited Germany.
Goldhagen, in Bonn to receive a prize from a small academic magazine, told journalists that the extreme right represented only a small part of Germany's current population.
